# karucode internal documentation

These files are generated from `@kc-doc` comments in the code. The agent reads the same
entries through the `karucode_docs` tool, compiled into the binary at build time.

Edit the code, not these files. Then run:

```bash
cargo run -p kc-docs -- --write   # regenerate
cargo run -p kc-docs -- --check   # what CI runs
```
